--- grant_on_all_tables_in_default_schema.sql
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA DEFAULT TO ROLE role1

--- AST
&ast.Grant{
  Privilege: &ast.PrivilegeOnAllTablesInSchema{
    Privileges: []ast.TablePrivilege{
      &ast.SelectPrivilege{
        Select: 6,
        Rparen: -1,
      },
    },
    Default: 37,
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 53,
      NameEnd: 58,
      Name:    "role1",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA DEFAULT TO ROLE role1
